system.description:
You are skilled at aiming your shots so that they have a chance of hitting more than one target.

Prerequisites: Point-Blank Shot, Precise Shot, Base Attack Bonus +6

Effect: If you miss when making a ranged attack against a target that has Soft Cover (that is, Cover provided by another character, creature, or Droid), you can immediately make an attack roll (with the same weapon and at the same attack bonus) against the target that is providing the Soft Cover. You can only use this Feat once per round.
